subject.title: feat: add /mark command for session label presets

question: Should OpenClaw permanently reserve a core `/mark` command and persisted mark metadata, and if so should the contract be generic and language-neutral rather than six hardcoded bilingual presets?
rationale: The patch creates a new built-in command namespace and durable session-state contract; source review can identify correctness defects, but only maintainers can decide whether this convenience belongs in core, a plugin, or a future generic session-tag surface.

options.title: Sponsor a generic core mark
options.body: Approve a language-neutral canonical mark field, require integration with every label/reset writer, and treat preset wording as presentation rather than persisted state.

options.title: Keep the preset command
options.body: Accept the six presets and bilingual session preference as a permanent core product contract after compatibility defects and proof are resolved.

options.title: Route presets outside core
options.body: Decline the built-in command and define any missing narrow session-metadata mutation API needed for a plugin or other optional package.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a generic core mark
recommendation.body: Approve a language-neutral canonical mark field, require integration with every label/reset writer, and treat preset wording as presentation rather than persisted state.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to recent session-persistence and metadata compatibility work.
